S84.10.note: The Settings screen says "Auto chooses a model for the current session" and does not say "default for new conversations"; the VS Code setting agiWorkforce.model is described as "Default LLM model" in apps/extension-vscode/package.json. I did not verify that a new chat starts with the chosen model.
steps: Click the gear icon titled Settings at the top of the AGI Code panel.
Click General in the left list.
Under Model and reasoning, find Model preference and click Choose.
Pick a model from the list and confirm it.
Close Settings, open a new chat, and check that the model shown is the one you picked.
Compare with Expected: a new conversation should start with the chosen model.
S84.10.where: Settings (gear icon, title "Settings", at the top of the AGI Code panel) > General > Model preference > Choose. Also the command "Code: Select Model".

S84.11.note: The Reasoning effort help text says "Used only by providers that expose an explicit reasoning-effort control", and the screen does not say "default for new turns". The levels are None, Minimal, Low, Medium, High, xHigh and Max. Whether a turn uses the chosen level depends on the provider, which I did not check.
steps: Click the gear icon titled Settings at the top of the AGI Code panel.
Click General in the left list.
Under Model and reasoning, find Reasoning effort and open its dropdown.
Pick a different level, for example High.
Close Settings, then reopen it and check that Reasoning effort still shows High.
Compare with Expected: the chosen level should be used for new turns.
S84.11.where: Settings (gear icon, title "Settings") > General > Reasoning effort. Also the slash command /effort in the composer.

S84.12.note: The modes in the code are Ask, Auto, Plan and Bypass permissions. There is no chat versus agent choice, so the Expected wording "chat vs agent/work" is not what the screen offers. Bypass permissions needs a separate risk confirmation.
steps: Click the gear icon titled Settings at the top of the AGI Code panel.
Click General in the left list.
Under Model and reasoning, find Agent mode and open its dropdown.
Pick Plan from the list.
Close Settings, then reopen it and check that Agent mode still shows Plan.
Compare with Expected: the mode chosen should be the one new conversations start in.
S84.12.where: Settings (gear icon, title "Settings") > General > Agent mode.

S84.15.note: AGI's own Settings panel has no keyboard shortcut section, so rebinding and disabling happen in VS Code's editor. The row wording and menu items for changing or removing a key come from VS Code, not from this repository. The default key bindings are listed in apps/extension-vscode/package.json.
steps: Click the More icon (ellipsis) at the top of the AGI Code panel.
Click Help.
Click Keyboard shortcuts. VS Code's Keyboard Shortcuts tab opens filtered to AGI Code.
Pick an AGI command row and use the pencil icon or the right-click menu to change its key, or remove its key to disable it.
Compare with Expected: you should be able to view, rebind and disable AGI shortcuts.
S84.15.where: More (ellipsis icon, title "More", at the top of the AGI Code panel) > Help > Keyboard shortcuts. The item opens VS Code's own Keyboard Shortcuts editor filtered to AGI Code.
